title: ASTRID run configuration V1
description: Input configuration for the run command. This is distinct from the saved runs/<run-id>/run.json summary.
$comment: The runner additionally checks that finite model.max_output_tokens does not exceed finite model.context_length. Schema defaults describe runtime behaviour; validation does not insert them.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference, for example ../schemas/run-config-v1.schema.json. It does not affect execution.

context_length.description: Configured context length in tokens. Null selects OpenRouter's advertised maximum.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per request. Null selects OpenRouter's advertised maximum, bounded by the configured context length. Endpoint constraints still apply.

supports_tools.description: Whether the configured model supports tool calls. False requires both tool budgets to be zero or omitted.

samples_per_task.description: Finite number of independent samples for each task.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Maximum tasks running concurrently with Kotlin coroutines. Omitted defaults to four; one runs tasks sequentially. Samples and repairs within each task remain sequential.

max_repair_turns.description: Maximum repairs after the initial attempt. Zero disables repairs; null removes the local repair cap.

max_tool_calls_per_attempt.description: Maximum calls to tools outside the workspace registry per attempt. Omitted or zero permits none; null removes this cap. Resets on repair.

max_workspace_tool_calls_per_attempt.description: Maximum workspace tool calls per attempt, including search_files. Omitted or zero disables workspace mode; a positive value or null enables it. Null removes this cap. Resets on repair.

max_agent_iterations.description: Maximum model requests across all attempts in one sample. Null removes the local request cap.
